title: Benchmarking Next-Generation Reasoning-Focused Large Language Models in Ophthalmology: A Head-to-Head Evaluation on 5,888 Items

live_model.evidence: "DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI o1 (o1-preview-2024-09-12), o3-mini (o3-mini-2025-01-31), and Gemini 2.0 Flash-Thinking" (Methods); "OpenAI o3-mini (0.857)" accuracy (Results, Table 2)

prompt.location: Supplemental Figure 3 (example of the zero-shot role-play prompt)
prompt.note: Prompt shown as an example in the supplement; JSON-style answer + explanation requested.

data.source: MedMCQA ophthalmology subset (public); the 5,888-item filtered subset (GPT-4o-mini quality filter, 182 DeepSeek timeouts excluded) is not released

notes: Soft gap: the exact 5,888-item subset must be reconstructed (filtering used gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 on explanations). Defaults used: temperature 1, reasoning_effort medium. Macro-F1 0.855 also reported.

resolution.plan: The zero-shot role-play prompt exists only as an example in Supplemental Figure 3 (image), and the GPT-4o-mini cleaning prompt only in Supplemental Figure 2. Read both from the PDF; rebuild the item set from the 6,990 MedMCQA ophthalmology items by re-running the gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 explanation filter (920 removed; the 182 DeepSeek-timeout exclusions cannot be reproduced), run o3-mini-2025-01-31 with reasoning_effort medium and default temperature, and compare accuracy 0.857 at set level.
resolution.approximation: Item set differs by up to ~3% from the 5,888 (filter nondeterminism, timeouts); prompt given as an example only.
